gap.missing_field: specific GitHub Actions validation element preventing job materialization
gap.blocking_dependency: provider check-run/parser annotation not exposed by current connector surface
gap.evidence_needed: observable validation diagnostic or minimal workflow reduction that changes jobs=[] to jobs>0
gap.falsifier: materialized job proving current pre-job classification false
gap.next_probe: enumerate all needs targets and all local uses references from ci.yml; verify graph closure against job keys/tree; if closed, prepare a minimal diagnostic workflow on audit branch rather than mutate ci.yml
gap.closure_gate: specific reproducible validation cause with observable evidence

memory_projection.L: V5 validation surface -> V6 local-action existence coverage
memory_projection.O: tree existence independently contradicts missing-local-action explanation for observed set
memory_projection.T: workflow local uses -> repository tree/action.yml identities
memory_projection.C: PRE_JOB cause unresolved; no hotfix promoted

F_ok: observed local composite-action paths resolve to action.yml
F_gap: complete needs/local-uses closure not yet enumerated
F_next: enumerate complete needs graph and local uses closure; only then create minimal diagnostic workflow if structural closure holds
